- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18229-18515 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The restored queue depth expires with the per-row stamp `_poller_queued_total_at` after 1800 s, but the 304 reuse path (18345-18368) refreshes the cache entry's TTL and never refreshes that stamp; the restore calls at 18306 (`reason=mktemp_failed`) and 18434 (`reason=fetch_unconfirmed`) use the same expiry.
  WHY: During a deep jam the in-progress list stays unchanged, so every 15-minute tick is a 304. After 1800 s `ACTIONS_QUEUED_TOTAL` stays empty and `queue_backpressure_holds_dispatch` takes the unknown branch (18507-18515) and returns 1. The hold fails open and stall recovery re-dispatches into the backed-up queue. Both reviewers rated it MAJOR. anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5 and z-ai_glm-5_3-flash chose not to raise it, calling it deliberate, documented fail-open (18198-18207, 18216-18223, 18221-18222, agents.d) that the last run did not change.
- changelog.d/stuck-backlog-phase3-queue-backpressure.md:7 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The changelog says `ACTIONS_QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE_HIGH=0` / `-1` turns the hold off. The poller reads that variable only from its own process environment (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18492), and .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml does not pass it (or `QUEUED_RUN_ZOMBIE_MINUTES`) through.
  WHY: An operator who sets the repo variable to `-1` to roll back still sees the hold engage at the script default of 150, and the bullet contradicts its own "read only from poller env" statement. minimax rated it NIT. z-ai_glm-5_3-flash treated it as an accepted residual because the bullet already discloses this.

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18229-18234, 18345-18368, 18507-18515, 18390 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The restored queue depth dies with the per-row stamp `_poller_queued_total_at` after 1800 s. The 304 reuse path writes `cached_runs` back unchanged (18350) and re-puts it with a fresh TTL (18352-18356) without refreshing the stamp. The new restore sites at 18306 and 18434 share the same expiry.
  WHY: With the 15-minute cron (`.github/workflows/internal-orchestrate-poll.yml:5`) and the 60 s TTL (`scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:3007`), every deep-jam tick is a 304. Tick 2 no longer restores the depth, so `QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE outcome=unknown queued=unknown high=150` is logged, the function returns 1 and the hold is off. The comment at 18204-18207 and the fragment do not mention the 30-minute limit. Fix direction: refresh the stamp on reuse while capping by a first-seen time (e.g. `now - first_seen < 3600`).
- changelog.d/stuck-backlog-phase3-queue-backpressure.md:7 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The changelog advertises `ACTIONS_QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE_HIGH=0` / `-1` as the kill switch, but the poller reads it only from its own env (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18492), and .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml passes neither it nor `QUEUED_RUN_ZOMBIE_MINUTES`.
  WHY: A repo variable set to `-1` has no effect, so the hold still engages at the default of 150. The same bullet contradicts itself.
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh 18299-18314 (`reason=mktemp_failed`): a partial `mktemp` failure returns at 18313 without removing the files already created (up to three leak). Fix: `rm -f "${response_file}" "${response_body_file}" "${response_err}" 2>/dev/null || true` before `return 0` (3 lines).
- HARDENING: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh 18492: the predicate writes the resolved default back into the global `ACTIONS_QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE_HIGH`. Fix: `local qbp_high="${ACTIONS_QUEUE_BACKPRESSURE_HIGH:-150}"` (2 lines).
- HARDENING: tests/test_poll_issue_run_linkage.py, next to `test_unconfirmed_fetch_fallback_restores_recent_queued_depth`: the `mktemp_failed` restore (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18306) is untested. Fix: add a `_cached_loader` case with a non-existent `TMPDIR` that asserts "400" (6 lines). HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2
- NOTE: Task gaps judged out of scope: clarify-respond wrappers (deferred at `agents.d/stuck-backlog-phase3-queue-backpressure.md:3`), `orchestrate_poll.yml` wiring (docs/plans/stuck-backlog-prevention-plan.md:126, forbidden by Scope item 3), reader audit PR-body placement (3 related items).
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
